purpose: Source-controlled alert policy to implement in Grafana or another operator-owned alert destination. Thresholds are recommendations until production acceptance evidence is recorded.

alerts.condition: 5xx responses >= 5 in 5 minutes OR >= 5% of API requests for 5 minutes
alerts.runbook: Check /api/ready, protected /api/ops/runtime, recent failures, database/Redis/Stripe provider status and latest deployment.
Inspect protected runtime route counters, database latency, external provider calls and cold-start frequency.

alerts.signal: structured log event / webhook HTTP failures
alerts.condition: Any repeated Stripe webhook processing failure or signature/configuration failure across 3 events in 10 minutes
alerts.runbook: Verify Stripe endpoint configuration/signing secret, inspect idempotency event table, and do not manually grant paid entitlements.

alerts.condition: Scheduled job fails entirely OR failure rate >= 10% for one completed run
alerts.runbook: Check provider configuration, bounded job result counters and the appropriate Resend/Web Push/Stripe provider status.

alerts.condition: launchReady=false or HTTP failure for 3 consecutive probes
alerts.runbook: Do not promote a new release. Inspect readiness checks and provider configuration before retrying.
